title: 推导式与生成器
subtitle: 省内存的惰性求值

blocks.text: 列表推导一次性构建全部元素;生成器表达式用 () 包裹,只在迭代时逐个产出,处理海量数据时内存占用是天壤之别。

blocks.code:
import sys

lst = [x * x for x in range(10000)]
gen = (x * x for x in range(10000))

print(lst[3], next(gen))
print('list bytes:', sys.getsizeof(lst))
print('gen  bytes:', sys.getsizeof(gen))

blocks.question: 处理 10GB 日志文件逐行统计,应优先使用?
blocks.explain: 生成器惰性求值,任意时刻只持有一行,内存占用恒定

blocks.text: sum(x*x for x in data) 比先建列表再求和更快更省内存

hint: 把 [] 换成 () 就成了生成器

title: 选对数据结构
subtitle: deque、集合与复杂度

blocks.text: list.pop(0) 要整体前移 O(n),collections.deque.popleft() 是 O(1);in 判断对 list 是 O(n),对 set 是 O(1)。数据量大时差距是数量级的。

blocks.code:
from collections import deque

d = deque([1, 2, 3])
d.append(4)
d.popleft()
print(list(d))

data = list(range(100000))
nums = set(data)
print(99999 in nums, 99999 in data)

blocks.title: 练习:timeit 计时
blocks.code:
import timeit

t1 = timeit.timeit('sum([i for i in range(100)])', number=1000)
t2 = timeit.timeit('sum(range(100))', number=1000)
print(t2 < t1)
blocks.hint: 内置 sum(range()) 少建一个列表

blocks.question: 需要频繁在头部插入/删除,应选择?
blocks.explain: deque 是双向链表实现,两端操作 O(1);list 头部操作要整体搬移
